inventory_count_items_quantities_check.name: inventory_count_items_quantities_check
inventory_count_items_quantities_check.value: ("inventory_count_items"."opening_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_items"."opening_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and ("inventory_count_items"."received_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_items"."received_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and ("inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

inventory_count_items_counted_check.name: inventory_count_items_counted_check
inventory_count_items_counted_check.value: ("inventory_count_items"."counted" and "inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" is not null) or (not "inventory_count_items"."counted" and "inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" is null)

inventory_counts_status_check.name: inventory_counts_status_check
inventory_counts_status_check.value: ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'draft' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'submitted' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'reviewed' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is not null)

inventory_days_status_check.name: inventory_days_status_check
inventory_days_status_check.value: ("inventory_days"."status" = 'open' and "inventory_days"."closed_by" is null and "inventory_days"."closed_at" is null) or ("inventory_days"."status" = 'closed' and "inventory_days"."closed_by" is not null and "inventory_days"."closed_at" is not null)

purchase_order_items_quantities_check.name: purchase_order_items_quantities_check
purchase_order_items_quantities_check.value: "purchase_order_items"."ordered_quantity" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "purchase_order_items"."received_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" between 0 and 9007199254740991

receipt_items_quantities_check.name: receipt_items_quantities_check
receipt_items_quantities_check.value: "receipt_items"."expected_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "receipt_items"."received_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "receipt_items"."unit_price_at_receipt" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "receipt_items"."received_amount" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and ("receipt_items"."condition" <> 'not_arrived' or "receipt_items"."received_quantity" = 0)

replenishment_request_items_quantities_c.name: replenishment_request_items_quantities_check
replenishment_request_items_quantities_c.value: ("replenishment_request_items"."suggested_quantity" is null or "replenishment_request_items"."suggested_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991) and "replenishment_request_items"."requested_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "replenishment_request_items"."fulfilled_quantity" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "replenishment_request_items"."unit_cost" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "replenishment_request_items"."line_total" between 0 and 9007199254740991

branch_transfers_acceptance_state_check.name: branch_transfers_acceptance_state_check
branch_transfers_acceptance_state_check.value: ("branch_transfers"."status" = 'pending' and "branch_transfers"."accepted_by" is null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_inventory_day_id" is null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_at" is null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_by" is null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("branch_transfers"."status" = 'accepted' and "branch_transfers"."accepted_by" is not null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_inventory_day_id" is not null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_at" is not null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_by" is null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("branch_transfers"."status" = 'cancelled' and "branch_transfers"."accepted_by" is null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_inventory_day_id" is null and "branch_transfers"."accepted_at" is null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_by" is not null and "branch_transfers"."cancelled_at" is not null)

users_role_branch_check.name: users_role_branch_check
users_role_branch_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'manager' and "users"."branch_id" is not null) or ("users"."role" <> 'manager' and "users"."branch_id" is null)
